purpose: V10-100 / section 26 responsibility and change-review register; not runtime or release qualification
ownership: Domain responsibility names describe code ownership boundaries. No named maintainer assignment is inferred. Existing CODEOWNERS covers release/dependency paths, not these production files.
maintenanceRule: For changes to a listed path, review its responsibilities, callers and characterization tests; update this register when a responsibility or import seam changes. Assign accountable maintainers through the repository governance owner.

metrics.fileSize: Recorded for the reviewed source hash; size alone is not a defect or gate.
metrics.dependencyGraph: Direct relative import edges only; aliases, dynamic imports, runtime wiring and transitive paths require change-specific review.
metrics.testTime: Use exact test receipts; not inferred here.

hotspots.responsibilities: Authenticated provider intake, conversation binding and authorized outbound publication
hotspots.extractionRule: Extract provider-specific transport or publication policy into existing chat/connectors adapters; retain current principal, replay and publication fences.

hotspots.responsibilities: Wake admission, run claiming, scheduling, execution and finalization
hotspots.extractionRule: Extend the existing admission, recovery, continuation or orchestration owner; preserve Task-before-Run lock order and physical Stop evidence.

hotspots.responsibilities: Connection credentials, grants, catalog discovery and provider authorization
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing credential, provider and lifecycle owners; do not add independent policy decisions to connection transport.

hotspots.responsibilities: HTTP validation, current actor authorization and Task command dispatch
hotspots.extractionRule: Keep transport validation in routes and move new lifecycle logic to its existing Task/domain service with transaction ownership intact.

hotspots.responsibilities: Pinned Native session preparation, provider transport, continuation and shutdown
hotspots.extractionRule: Extract only an owned preparation, identity or transport seam; preserve immutable manifests, current source checks and Stop/erasure proof.

hotspots.responsibilities: Task persistence, privacy, assignment, checkout, comments and post-commit effects
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing Task privacy, admission and mutation seams; keep checkout atomic and post-commit effects outside the database transaction.

hotspots.responsibilities: Run-bound tool discovery, admission, approval and effect dispatch
hotspots.extractionRule: Extend operation adapters and existing policy evaluators; preserve ledger idempotency, current authority and unknown-effect reconciliation.

hotspots.responsibilities: Runtime lease, workspace provisioning and control
hotspots.extractionRule: Use the existing runtime control and lease services; preserve target identity, generation fencing and cleanup receipts.

hotspots.responsibilities: HTTP commands for Agent configuration, lifecycle and runtime access
hotspots.extractionRule: Delegate new lifecycle behavior to existing Agent services; keep validation and transport mapping in routes.

hotspots.responsibilities: Task detail composition, work history and command controls
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing Task components/hooks/API clients; keep server authority and company/session cache boundaries.

hotspots.responsibilities: Company Skill versions, visibility, installation and execution bindings
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing version, artifact and delivery owners; do not infer runtime qualification from file delivery.

hotspots.responsibilities: Published workflow execution and governed step progression
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing step adapters and workflow state owners; preserve publication revision, checkpoints, Stop and effect accounting.

hotspots.responsibilities: Authorized import/export planning, validation and durable application
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing import ledger and source export owners; preserve tenant mapping, accepted-plan pins and resumable effect receipts.

hotspots.responsibilities: Company Skill screen and progressive shell selection
hotspots.extractionRule: Converge only after route/flag migration evidence; avoid adding another parallel screen.

hotspots.responsibilities: Retained production Skill surface
hotspots.extractionRule: Retire only after current mounted-route, permission and migration evidence proves replacement coverage.

hotspots.responsibilities: Task messages, attachments and composer interactions
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing composer/thread components and hooks; preserve paused drafts, current identity and explicit command semantics.

hotspots.responsibilities: Pipeline list, authoring and publication controls
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing workflow API and editor seams; keep Human publication separate from Agent proposals.

hotspots.responsibilities: Credential scope, configuration and connection recovery
hotspots.extractionRule: Reuse credential forms and owner APIs; never expose secret values or infer grants from displayed ownership.

hotspots.responsibilities: Co-worker detail and progressive shell selection
hotspots.extractionRule: Reuse current detail components; converge variants only with current mounted-route and permission evidence.

hotspots.responsibilities: Retained production Co-worker detail
hotspots.extractionRule: Retire only after replacement, deep-link and migration qualification.

hotspots.responsibilities: Agent configuration forms and validation presentation
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing authored-definition and adapter-field contracts; keep execution authority on the server.

hotspots.responsibilities: Connection setup, scope disclosure and recovery
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing provider setup steps and connection owner; preserve purpose, consent and account/company identity.

hotspots.responsibilities: Starter company and Co-worker setup flow
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing onboarding steps and activation owner; do not activate recurring automation implicitly.

hotspots.responsibilities: Current Inbox composition and progressive selection
hotspots.extractionRule: Use existing attention projections and action owners; preserve current source authorization.

hotspots.responsibilities: Retained legacy Inbox surface
hotspots.extractionRule: Retire only with route, deep-link, flag and migration evidence; do not build a third inbox.
